public.prompt: Signal Repair: complete a controller's missing routing decision and execute it. Exactly one listed operating world is current. The truthful binary probe table and successful worlds for every action are public. Across the entire episode, at most 1 distinct probe readings may be flipped. This is one shared corruption limit, not a new allowance for each probe. Each probe can be used once. Choose evidence and then commit an action irreversibly. Success requires the actual operation to succeed AND that the pre-commit observations justify that action in every world compatible with the corruption limit. Full world identification is unnecessary when one action succeeds in all remaining worlds. The operational budget limits probe costs plus the committed action separately from setup-read credits; unused setup credits cannot increase that limit. Complete the action and evidence holes after committing. For each world where the chosen action would fail, cite at least k+1 distinct observed probes contradicting that world's truthful table. Read /formal/robust-sensing.json.
